#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a Project Kickoff Meeting ICS entry: next Monday, 10:00-12:00 local time."""
import sys
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, date

OUT_PATH = "project_kickoff.ics"


def next_monday(d: date) -> date:
    """Return the Monday strictly after d (Monday of next week)."""
    days_ahead = (0 - d.weekday()) % 7  # Monday == 0
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return d + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def local_offset_for(dt: datetime) -> timedelta:
    """Best-effort UTC offset for a naive local datetime."""
    # Attach the local timezone to the datetime and read its offset.
    aware = dt.astimezone()
    return aware.utcoffset() or timedelta(0)


def main() -> int:
    today = date.today()
    monday = next_monday(today)

    start_local = datetime(monday.year, monday.month, monday.day, 10, 0, 0)
    end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=2)

    offset = local_offset_for(start_local)
    start_utc = (start_local - offset).replace(tzinfo=None)
    end_utc = (end_local - offset).replace(tzinfo=None)

    fmt = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"
    dtstart = start_utc.strftime(fmt)
    dtend = end_utc.strftime(fmt)
    dtstamp = datetime.utcnow().strftime(fmt)
    uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar-skill.local"

    ics = (
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\n"
        "VERSION:2.0\r\n"
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN\r\n"
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN\r\n"
        "METHOD:PUBLISH\r\n"
        "BEGIN:VEVENT\r\n"
        f"UID:{uid}\r\n"
        f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}\r\n"
        f"DTSTART:{dtstart}\r\n"
        f"DTEND:{dtend}\r\n"
        "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting\r\n"
        "DESCRIPTION:Kickoff meeting for the project.\r\n"
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED\r\n"
        "SEQUENCE:0\r\n"
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE\r\n"
        "BEGIN:VALARM\r\n"
        "ACTION:DISPLAY\r\n"
        "DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts soon\r\n"
        "TRIGGER:-PT15M\r\n"
        "END:VALARM\r\n"
        "END:VEVENT\r\n"
        "END:VCALENDAR\r\n"
    )

    with open(OUT_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        f.write(ics)

    # --- Validation: re-parse the generated file ---
    try:
        from icalendar import Calendar  # may not be installed; fallback below
        with open(OUT_PATH, "rb") as f:
            cal = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
        events = [c for c in cal.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
        assert len(events) == 1, f"expected 1 event, got {len(events)}"
        ev = events[0]
        assert ev.get("summary") == "Project Kickoff Meeting"
        assert ev.get("dtstart").dt == start_utc
        assert ev.get("dtend").dt == end_utc
        validation = "valid (icalendar)"
    except ImportError:
        # Manual sanity checks
        with open(OUT_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            content = f.read()
        assert content.startswith("BEGIN:VCALENDAR")
        assert "END:VCALENDAR" in content
        assert "BEGIN:VEVENT" in content and "END:VEVENT" in content
        assert f"DTSTART:{dtstart}" in content
        assert f"DTEND:{dtend}" in content
        assert content.count("BEGIN:VEVENT") == 1
        validation = "valid (manual checks)"

    print(f"Today:        {today.isoformat()} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
    print(f"Next Monday:  {monday.isoformat()}")
    print(f"Start (local): {start_local.isoformat()}  (UTC offset {offset})")
    print(f"End (local):   {end_local.isoformat()}")
    print(f"Start (UTC):   {start_utc.isoformat()}")
    print(f"End (UTC):     {end_utc.isoformat()}")
    print(f"UID:         {uid}")
    print(f"Output:      {OUT_PATH}")
    print(f"Validation:  {validation}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
